phases.name: prepare
phases.description: Chest expands; fists beside helmet; mouth closed

phases.name: roar-start
phases.description: Upward gaze and open mouth; fists rise

phases.name: roar-peak
phases.description: Wider open mouth and lifted chin; fists higher

suggestedSequence: Prepare0 -> start1 -> peak2, then hold the peak while the supply scene is active.
timing: Controlled by game supply-scene code; no frame durations are baked into the asset.
